title: COO1: Plan: member chat in channel middle column
summary: I've written the plan; no files were changed. The main finding is that this needs no backend or desktop work. Today the channel chat is just the coordinator's own chat with the channel's posts merged in (`app/mod.rs:1655`). So opening a member's chat can simply put that member on screen while the channel stays open, and the composer then replies to them at no extra cost.
